name: Booking & Payment Workflow
business_goal: Allow parents/students to book and pay for tutoring sessions through a managed platform flow.
description: Parent/student selects tutor, subject and time, pays through WooCommerce/PayFast or Peach, then the system creates Amelia booking, updates FluentCRM, creates calendar/LMS artefacts and sends notifications.
trigger: WooCommerce payment completed OR Amelia booking created with paid status.
